verdict.rationale: Snyk's per-language CLI docs show dependency and source scanning for Java/Kotlin (Maven, Gradle), JavaScript (npm, Yarn workspaces), .NET (solution/project files) and Python, alongside SAST via `snyk code test` and IaC/container scanning. Together these cover the core of multi-ecosystem scanning. A community user confirms real-world npm scanning with Snyk's own vulnerability database. Missing for 10: evidence for other major ecosystems (e.g. Go, Ruby, PHP, Swift, Rust), a complete supported-languages matrix in the pack, and independent corroboration of breadth and accuracy across ecosystems.
